story.title: Ava's Habitat Helpers
story.introLine: Hi Ava! Let's explore the cozy homes where our animal friends live and grow.
story.closingLine: Now it is your turn to help these animals find their perfect homes!

scenes.title: The Sunny Savanna
scenes.narration: Look at the tall, golden grass! A mother lion rests in the shade of a big acacia tree. Animals need food, water, and a safe place to sleep to stay healthy and happy in the wild.
scenes.imagePrompt: Polished 2D children educational game art of a sunny savanna with golden grass, a flat-topped acacia tree, and a friendly lioness resting in the shade. Bright blue sky with soft clouds.

scenes.title: The Deep Blue Ocean
scenes.narration: Under the waves, colorful fish swim through the coral reefs. This watery world provides everything they need to survive. Can you help match each animal to the special place where they belong?
scenes.imagePrompt: Polished 2D children educational game art of a vibrant underwater coral reef with purple and orange corals, small bubbles, and schools of friendly tropical fish swimming in clear blue water.

narration.transcript: Hi Ava! Let's explore the cozy homes where our animal friends live and grow. Look at the tall, golden grass! A mother lion rests in the shade of a big acacia tree. Animals need food, water, and a safe place to sleep to stay healthy and happy in the wild. Under the waves, colorful fish swim through the coral reefs. This watery world provides everything they need to survive. Can you help match each animal to the special place where they belong? Now it is your turn to help these animals find their perfect homes!
